content: Unlocked by CL-7 (bam_aux_get replacement). The C function (65 lines) finds the existing tag via bam_aux_get, computes the minimal integer encoding (i8/i16/i32), resizes the data buffer if the new encoding differs in size, and writes the value. Our aux_tag_search + aux_payload_size already handle the find+size logic. Needs: buffer resize (realloc of bam1_t.data via possibly_expand_bam_data pattern) + little-endian write.
